name: QR Code Generator
tagline: Generate QR codes from any text or URL
description: Create customizable QR codes instantly from any text, URL, or data. Choose colors, size and error correction level, then download the result as PNG.

expert_defs.name: qrcode_generate_qr
expert_defs.description: Generates a QR code PNG image from text or URL using the qrserver.com API. Params: data — text or URL to encode; size — image width/height in pixels (default 300); fill_hex — QR module color as hex without # (default 000000); back_hex — background color as hex without # (default FFFFFF); ecl — error correction level L/M/Q/H (default M). Returns JSON string with output_type image_base64 and PNG encoded as base64.

conceptTexts: Plugin: QR Code Generator (id: qrcode). Expert qrcode_generate_qr creates QR code PNG images via the qrserver.com REST API (no authentication required). Params: data (string — text or URL to encode, required), size (integer — image size in pixels, default 300, range 100-1000), fill_hex (hex color without # for QR modules, default 000000), back_hex (hex color without # for background, default FFFFFF), ecl (error correction level: L=7%, M=15%, Q=25%, H=30%, default M). The expert returns {output_type: 'image_base64', data: '<base64 PNG string>', filename: 'qrcode.png'}. Use run_expert('qrcode_generate_qr', {data: '...', size: '300', fill_hex: '000000', back_hex: 'FFFFFF', ecl: 'M'}) to generate a QR code.
